aboutThis.dialog.title: About “{name}”

@aboutThis.dialog.title.description: Title of the "Tell me about this" card, a dialog that lists what Cmdr knows about one file or folder: where it came from, what it is, what it belongs to, and what removing it would mean. {name} is the item's file or folder name, exactly as it appears in the file list.

name.description: The file or folder name, for example "report.pdf".

@aboutThis.dialog.close.description: Button at the bottom right of the "Tell me about this" card. Closes it; nothing else happens.

@aboutThis.dialog.lookingUp.description: Screen-reader text on a row of the "Tell me about this" card whose answer hasn't arrived yet (it shows a gray placeholder bar). Short, no closing period.

@aboutThis.section.origin.description: Section heading on the "Tell me about this" card: where the item came from (a download record, or a copy or move Cmdr made). Sentence case.

@aboutThis.section.nature.description: Section heading on the "Tell me about this" card: what the item is (its size and dates, what its contents really are, its code signature). Sentence case.

@aboutThis.section.use.description: Section heading on the "Tell me about this" card: how the item is used (when it was last opened, the app that opens it, how important a folder is). Sentence case.

@aboutThis.section.context.description: Section heading on the "Tell me about this" card: what the item belongs to (the app that owns it, the git repository around it). Sentence case.

@aboutThis.section.contents.description: Section heading on the "Tell me about this" card for a folder: what the folder holds. Sentence case.

@aboutThis.section.removal.description: Section heading on the "Tell me about this" card, always the last one: what deleting the item would mean (for example "Git can't bring it back"). It describes consequences only; it never says deleting is safe. Sentence case.

@aboutThis.section.nothingOnRecord.description: The one muted line a section of the "Tell me about this" card shows when none of its rows had anything recorded (for example no download record and no copy by Cmdr). Ordinary, not a warning. No closing period.

aboutThis.volumeNote.identityOnly: On {volume}, Cmdr can see the name, size, and dates.

@aboutThis.volumeNote.identityOnly.description: Note at the top of the "Tell me about this" card when the item sits on a drive or server that only reports names, sizes, and dates (a phone, a network share). Said once instead of on every row.

volume.description: The drive's or server's name, for example "Naspolya" or "Pixel 8".

aboutThis.volumeNote.someFacts: On {volume}, Cmdr can see only some of this.

@aboutThis.volumeNote.someFacts.description: Note at the top of the "Tell me about this" card when the item's drive or server answers some questions but not all of them. Said once instead of on every row.

volume.description: The drive's or server's name, for example "Naspolya".

aboutThis.volumeNote.unreachable: {volume} stopped answering, so Cmdr can’t tell more right now.

@aboutThis.volumeNote.unreachable.description: Note at the top of the "Tell me about this" card when the item's drive or server stopped responding while Cmdr was looking. Said once; the rows below it stay short.

volume.description: The drive's or server's name, for example "Naspolya".

aboutThis.unavailable.unknownVolume: Cmdr doesn’t know the drive this item is on anymore.

@aboutThis.unavailable.unknownVolume.description: The whole body of the "Tell me about this" card when Cmdr can't look at the item at all because its drive was removed from Cmdr's list since the pane showed it.

aboutThis.unavailable.pathOutsideVolume: Cmdr couldn’t place this item on its drive.

@aboutThis.unavailable.pathOutsideVolume.description: The whole body of the "Tell me about this" card when the item's location doesn't fit the drive the pane says it's on.

aboutThis.unavailable.noVolumeAtPath: The drive this item was on isn’t connected.

@aboutThis.unavailable.noVolumeAtPath.description: The whole body of the "Tell me about this" card when the item's drive was disconnected.

aboutThis.unavailable.notFound: This item isn’t there anymore. It may have been moved or removed.

@aboutThis.unavailable.notFound.description: The whole body of the "Tell me about this" card when the file or folder no longer exists at its place.

aboutThis.unavailable.permissionDenied: {platform, select, macos {macOS didn’t let Cmdr look at this item.} windows {Windows didn’t let Cmdr look at this item.} other {The system didn’t let Cmdr look at this item.}}

@aboutThis.unavailable.permissionDenied.description: The whole body of the "Tell me about this" card when the operating system refused to describe the item (no permission). The branches name the user's operating system.

aboutThis.unavailable.unreachable: The drive didn’t answer in time. Give it another try in a moment.

@aboutThis.unavailable.unreachable.description: The whole body of the "Tell me about this" card when the item's drive or server didn't respond within a few seconds.

aboutThis.unavailable.unreadable: Cmdr couldn’t read anything about this item.

@aboutThis.unavailable.unreadable.description: The whole body of the "Tell me about this" card when reading the item stopped for another reason.

@aboutThis.label.download.description: Row label on the "Tell me about this" card, left of what the operating system recorded about where the item was downloaded from. A past participle, like a form label.

@aboutThis.label.cmdrOperation.description: Row label on the "Tell me about this" card, left of the copy, move, or extraction Cmdr itself made that put the item where it is.

@aboutThis.label.size.description: Row label on the "Tell me about this" card, left of the item's size.

@aboutThis.label.created.description: Row label on the "Tell me about this" card, left of the date the item was created.

@aboutThis.label.modified.description: Row label on the "Tell me about this" card, left of the date the item last changed.

@aboutThis.label.otherNames.description: Row label on the "Tell me about this" card, left of how many other names (hard links) point to the same file contents.

@aboutThis.label.pointsTo.description: Row label on the "Tell me about this" card for a symbolic link, left of the place the link points to.

@aboutThis.label.realType.description: Row label on the "Tell me about this" card, left of what the file's contents really are (for example "Disk image"), as Cmdr read them from its first bytes.

@aboutThis.label.bundle.description: Row label on the "Tell me about this" card for an app or package, left of the name, version, and identifier the app's own description file states.

@aboutThis.label.signature.description: Row label on the "Tell me about this" card, left of the code signature an app or program carries (who signed it).

@aboutThis.label.lastOpened.description: Row label on the "Tell me about this" card, left of the date the system recorded the item as last opened.

@aboutThis.label.defaultApp.description: Row label on the "Tell me about this" card, left of the app that opens the file by default.

@aboutThis.label.importance.description: Row label on the "Tell me about this" card for a folder, left of how important Cmdr's drive index scores the folder (high, medium, low).

@aboutThis.label.owner.description: Row label on the "Tell me about this" card, left of the app or installer the item belongs to.

@aboutThis.label.git.description: Row label on the "Tell me about this" card, left of the git repository the item sits in and its state there. "Git" is the version-control tool's name; keep it.

@aboutThis.label.contents.description: Row label on the "Tell me about this" card for a folder, left of how many items sit directly in it.

@aboutThis.label.appData.description: Row label on the "Tell me about this" card for an app, left of the folders in the user's Library folder that are named after the app and stay behind if the app is removed. "Library" is the macOS folder of that name.

@aboutThis.unknown.noRecord.description: Muted one-line answer on a "Tell me about this" card row when nothing recorded this fact. Ordinary, not a warning. It doesn't say "never": no record isn't the same as it never happened. No closing period.

@aboutThis.unknown.notInStatus.description: Muted one-line answer on the Git row of the "Tell me about this" card when git's list of changes doesn't name the item: it may be committed with no changes, or ignored. Ordinary, not a warning. No closing period.

@aboutThis.unknown.noInstalledAppMatches.description: Muted one-line answer on the "Belongs to" row of the "Tell me about this" card when no installed app matches the folder's name, somewhere an owner isn't expected. Ordinary, not a warning. No closing period.

@aboutThis.unknown.volumeCantTell.description: Muted one-line answer on a "Tell me about this" card row when the item's drive or server doesn't report this fact. The card's note at the top already explains it once. Short, no closing period.

aboutThis.unknown.libraryNameMatchesNoAp: No installed app has this folder’s name.

@aboutThis.unknown.libraryNameMatchesNoA.description: Answer on the "Belongs to" row of the "Tell me about this" card for a folder in the macOS Library folder that is named like an app, when no installed app has that name. It doesn't claim the folder is left over.

aboutThis.unknown.notIndexed: Cmdr’s drive index doesn’t cover this yet.

@aboutThis.unknown.notIndexed.description: Answer on a "Tell me about this" card row (a folder's size or importance) when Cmdr's drive index hasn't scanned the place yet.

aboutThis.unknown.timedOut: Cmdr didn’t get an answer in time.

@aboutThis.unknown.timedOut.description: Answer on a "Tell me about this" card row when looking up that one fact took too long (about a second) and Cmdr stopped waiting.

@aboutThis.unknown.unreachable.description: Answer on a "Tell me about this" card row when the item's drive or server stopped responding.

aboutThis.unknown.permissionDenied: {platform, select, macos {macOS didn’t let Cmdr read this.} windows {Windows didn’t let Cmdr read this.} other {The system didn’t let Cmdr read this.}}

@aboutThis.unknown.permissionDenied.description: Answer on a "Tell me about this" card row when the operating system refused Cmdr access to that fact. The branches name the user's operating system.

aboutThis.unknown.protected: This is a private place, so Cmdr doesn’t look inside.

@aboutThis.unknown.protected.description: Answer on a "Tell me about this" card row when the item sits somewhere Cmdr deliberately doesn't read (for example a folder of keys or passwords).

aboutThis.unknown.nodeChangedSince: Cmdr has a record for this name, and the file has been replaced since.

@aboutThis.unknown.nodeChangedSince.description: Answer on the "Cmdr's history" row of the "Tell me about this" card when Cmdr's log has a copy or move to this name, but the file there now is a different one (it was saved over or replaced), so the record doesn't apply to it.

aboutThis.unknown.ambiguous: Several could fit, so Cmdr doesn’t pick one.

@aboutThis.unknown.ambiguous.description: Answer on a "Tell me about this" card row when more than one answer fits equally and Cmdr won't guess.

aboutThis.unknown.unparseable: There’s a record, and Cmdr can’t read it.

@aboutThis.unknown.unparseable.description: Answer on a "Tell me about this" card row when the operating system or a tool kept a record of this fact in a form Cmdr can't read.

aboutThis.unknown.refusedInBackground: Cmdr doesn’t reach this drive on its own.

@aboutThis.unknown.refusedInBackground.description: Answer on a "Tell me about this" card row when the item is on a network or device drive and Cmdr was asked about it without the user doing anything, so it didn't connect.

@aboutThis.notApplicable.noCodeSigningOn.description: Muted one-line answer on the Signature row of the "Tell me about this" card on an operating system that has no code signing to read. No closing period.

@aboutThis.notApplicable.notInARepo.description: Muted one-line answer on the Git row of the "Tell me about this" card when the item isn't inside a git repository. No closing period.

@aboutThis.notApplicable.notABundle.description: Muted one-line answer on the Bundle row of the "Tell me about this" card when the folder isn't an app or package and so has no bundle name or version. No closing period.

aboutThis.notApplicable.volumeHasNone: This drive keeps no such record

@aboutThis.notApplicable.volumeHasNone.description: Muted one-line answer on a "Tell me about this" card row when the item's drive keeps no record of this kind at all (a phone has no download records). No closing period.

@aboutThis.download.noRecord.description: Muted one-line answer on the "Downloaded" row of the "Tell me about this" card when the system recorded no download for the item (most files a person made themselves). Ordinary, not a warning. No closing period.

aboutThis.download.fromSite: {platform, select, macos {macOS recorded this as downloaded from {host}{hasApp, select, yes { with {app}} other {}}{hasDate, select, yes { on <date></date>} other {}}.} other {Your browser recorded this as downloaded from {host}{hasApp, select, yes { with {app}} other {}}{hasDate, select, yes { on <date></date>} other {}}.}}

@aboutThis.download.fromSite.description: Answer on the "Downloaded" row of the "Tell me about this" card. It says what the system RECORDED, not that Cmdr checked it: anyone can write such a record. <date></date> becomes the download date. macOS keeps the record itself; on other systems the browser writes it.

app.description: The app that downloaded it, for example "Chrome" or "Safari".

hasApp.description: "yes" when the record names the app.

hasDate.description: "yes" when the record has a date.

aboutThis.download.fromAddress: {platform, select, macos {macOS recorded this as downloaded from the address {address}.} other {Your browser recorded this as downloaded from the address {address}.}}

@aboutThis.download.fromAddress.description: Answer on the "Downloaded" row of the "Tell me about this" card when the recorded source is a numeric internet address rather than a website name. It says what was recorded, not that Cmdr checked it.

address.description: A numeric internet address, for example "192.0.2.7".

aboutThis.download.linkedFrom: The record also names a page on {host}.

@aboutThis.download.linkedFrom.description: Second line on the "Downloaded" row of the "Tell me about this" card when the download record names the page the download link was on, at a different website than the file itself (browsers record both).

host.description: The page's website name, for example "github.com".

@aboutThis.download.copyLink.description: Accessible name and hover hint of the copy button beside the download source on the "Tell me about this" card. It copies the whole recorded web address, of which the card shows only the website name.

@aboutThis.download.copyPageLink.description: Accessible name and hover hint of the copy button beside the line naming the page the download link was on, on the "Tell me about this" card. It copies that page's whole recorded web address.

aboutThis.download.mail: macOS recorded this as a Mail attachment{hasSender, select, yes {, from {sender}} other {}}.

@aboutThis.download.mail.description: Answer on the "Downloaded" row of the "Tell me about this" card when macOS recorded the file as saved from an email in Apple Mail. It says what was recorded, not that Cmdr checked it.

sender.description: The sender as Mail wrote it, a name or an email address.

hasSender.description: "yes" when the record names a sender.

@aboutThis.download.mailSubject.description: Second line on the "Downloaded" row of the "Tell me about this" card for a Mail attachment: the subject line of the email it came with, as Mail recorded it.

aboutThis.download.airDrop: macOS recorded this as received over AirDrop from {sender}.

@aboutThis.download.airDrop.description: Answer on the "Downloaded" row of the "Tell me about this" card when macOS recorded the file as received over AirDrop. "AirDrop" is Apple's feature name. It says what was recorded, not that Cmdr checked it.

sender.description: The sending person's or device's name, as recorded.

aboutThis.download.inlineData: {platform, select, macos {macOS recorded a source that holds the data itself, which Cmdr doesn’t show.} other {The browser recorded a source that holds the data itself, which Cmdr doesn’t show.}}

@aboutThis.download.inlineData.description: Answer on the "Downloaded" row of the "Tell me about this" card when the recorded source is a data address that contains the file's own contents (a "data:" or "blob:" link), so there's no website to name.

aboutThis.download.localFile: {platform, select, macos {macOS recorded this as coming from a file on this computer.} other {The browser recorded this as coming from a file on this computer.}}

@aboutThis.download.localFile.description: Answer on the "Downloaded" row of the "Tell me about this" card when the recorded source is a file on the same computer (a "file:" link).

aboutThis.download.unrecognized: {platform, select, macos {macOS recorded a source Cmdr can’t read as an address: {text}} other {The browser recorded a source Cmdr can’t read as an address: {text}}}

@aboutThis.download.unrecognized.description: Answer on the "Downloaded" row of the "Tell me about this" card when the recorded source is text Cmdr can't read as a web address. The text follows the colon as it was recorded.

text.description: The recorded text, shortened if long.

aboutThis.download.noSource: macOS recorded this as downloaded{hasApp, select, yes { with {app}} other {}}{hasDate, select, yes { on <date></date>} other {}}, without saying from where.

@aboutThis.download.noSource.description: Answer on the "Downloaded" row of the "Tell me about this" card when macOS recorded that the file was downloaded but not where from. <date></date> becomes the download date.

app.description: The app that downloaded it, for example "Chrome".

hasApp.description: "yes" when the record names the app.

hasDate.description: "yes" when the record has a date.

aboutThis.cmdrOperation.noRecord: No copy or move by Cmdr on record

@aboutThis.cmdrOperation.noRecord.description: Muted one-line answer on the "Cmdr's history" row of the "Tell me about this" card when Cmdr's own log has no copy, move, or extraction that put this very file here. Ordinary, not a warning. No closing period.

aboutThis.cmdrOperation.done: {who, select, you {You} askCmdr {Ask Cmdr} other {An AI client}} {kind, select, copy {copied this here} move {moved this here} rename {gave this its name} create {created this} extract {extracted this here} compress {made this archive} other {moved this here when deleting it}} with Cmdr on <date></date>.

@aboutThis.cmdrOperation.done.description: Answer on the "Cmdr's history" row of the "Tell me about this" card: which Cmdr operation put the item where it is, who started it, and when. <date></date> becomes the date. "Ask Cmdr" is the name of Cmdr's built-in assistant; keep it. "An AI client" is another AI app that was driving Cmdr.

who.description: Who started it: the user ("you"), Cmdr's assistant ("askCmdr"), or another AI app.

kind.description: What the operation did: copy, move, rename, create, extract, compress, or trash.

@aboutThis.cmdrOperation.from.description: Second line on the "Cmdr's history" row of the "Tell me about this" card: where the item was copied or moved from. <source></source> becomes the original path; {volume} names the drive or server it was on when that differs. No closing period.

volume.description: The drive's or server's name, for example "Naspolya".

hasVolume.description: "yes" when the source was on another drive.

@aboutThis.cmdrOperation.copySource.description: Accessible name and hover hint of the copy button beside the original path on the "Cmdr's history" row. It copies the full path.

@aboutThis.identity.onDisk.description: Muted addition after the item's size on the "Tell me about this" card when the space it takes on the drive differs from its size. <size></size> becomes that size, for example "4 KB".

aboutThis.identity.otherNames: {count, plural, one {One other name points to the same contents} other {{countText} other names point to the same contents}}

@aboutThis.identity.otherNames.description: Answer on the "Other names" row of the "Tell me about this" card: how many other names (hard links) lead to this same file contents. No closing period.

count.description: How many other names, as a number.

@aboutThis.identity.copyLinkTarget.description: Accessible name and hover hint of the copy button beside the "Points to" row of a symbolic link on the "Tell me about this" card. It copies the full target path.

@aboutThis.realType.matches.description: Answer on the "Kind" row of the "Tell me about this" card when the file's contents match what its extension says. No closing period.

kind.description: The kind of file, for example "Disk image" or "PDF".

aboutThis.realType.mismatch: The contents say {kind}, while the name ends in .{extension}.

@aboutThis.realType.mismatch.description: Answer on the "Kind" row of the "Tell me about this" card when the file's contents are a different kind than its extension says (for example a program named like a photo). Shown with a warning mark.

kind.description: What the contents really are, for example "Mac program".

extension.description: The file's extension without the dot, for example "jpg".

@aboutThis.realType.byName.description: Answer on the "Kind" row of the "Tell me about this" card when Cmdr can't tell from the contents (plain text, for example) and the extension names a kind. No closing period.

kind.description: The kind the extension claims, for example "Text".

aboutThis.realType.unrecognized: Cmdr doesn’t know this kind of contents

@aboutThis.realType.unrecognized.description: Answer on the "Kind" row of the "Tell me about this" card when neither the contents nor the extension tell what kind of file it is. No closing period.

@aboutThis.kind.diskImage.description: A kind of file on the "Tell me about this" card: a macOS disk image (.dmg).

@aboutThis.kind.installerPackage.description: A kind of file on the "Tell me about this" card: a macOS installer package (.pkg).

@aboutThis.kind.machO.description: A kind of file on the "Tell me about this" card: a program that runs on macOS.

@aboutThis.kind.elf.description: A kind of file on the "Tell me about this" card: a program that runs on Linux.

@aboutThis.kind.windowsProgram.description: A kind of file on the "Tell me about this" card: a program or installer for Windows.

@aboutThis.kind.otherCode.description: A kind of file on the "Tell me about this" card: other compiled code (Java, WebAssembly, Android).

@aboutThis.kind.script.description: A kind of file on the "Tell me about this" card: a script a program runs, such as a shell script.

@aboutThis.kind.archive.description: A kind of file on the "Tell me about this" card: an archive such as a zip file.

@aboutThis.kind.pdf.description: A kind of file on the "Tell me about this" card: a PDF document.

@aboutThis.kind.image.description: A kind of file on the "Tell me about this" card: a photo or other image.

@aboutThis.kind.video.description: A kind of file on the "Tell me about this" card: a video.

@aboutThis.kind.audio.description: A kind of file on the "Tell me about this" card: music or other sound.

@aboutThis.kind.font.description: A kind of file on the "Tell me about this" card: a font.

@aboutThis.kind.document.description: A kind of file on the "Tell me about this" card: an office document or an e-book.

@aboutThis.kind.database.description: A kind of file on the "Tell me about this" card: a database file.

@aboutThis.kind.text.description: A kind of file on the "Tell me about this" card: plain text, web pages included.

@aboutThis.kind.other.description: A kind of file on the "Tell me about this" card when Cmdr recognizes the format but has no family name for it.

@aboutThis.kind.unrecognized.description: A kind of file on the "Tell me about this" card when the contents match no format Cmdr knows.

@aboutThis.what.fileWithExtension.description: What an item is, at the start of the one-line summary at the top of the "Tell me about this" card, when Cmdr knows only the file's extension. For example ".md file".

extension.description: The extension without the dot, for example "md".

@aboutThis.what.file.description: What an item is, at the start of the one-line summary at the top of the "Tell me about this" card, when nothing more specific is known.

@aboutThis.what.folder.description: What an item is, at the start of the one-line summary at the top of the "Tell me about this" card: a folder.

@aboutThis.what.app.description: What an item is, at the start of the one-line summary at the top of the "Tell me about this" card: an app, with its version when the app states one.

version.description: The version as the app states it, for example "4.41.97".

hasVersion.description: "yes" when the app states a version.

@aboutThis.what.package.description: What an item is, at the start of the one-line summary at the top of the "Tell me about this" card: a folder the system shows as one item (a document package, a framework).

@aboutThis.what.symlink.description: What an item is, at the start of the one-line summary at the top of the "Tell me about this" card: a symbolic link to another place.

@aboutThis.what.archiveEntry.description: What an item is, at the start of the one-line summary at the top of the "Tell me about this" card: a file or folder inside a zip or other archive.

aboutThis.headline.plain: {what}{sizeShown, select, exact {, <size></size>} atLeast {, at least <size></size>} other {}}

@aboutThis.headline.plain.description: The one-line summary at the top of the "Tell me about this" card when nothing beyond the kind and size is known. <size></size> becomes the size, for example "2.1 MB". No closing period.

what.description: What the item is, for example "PDF" or "Folder".

sizeShown.description: "exact", "atLeast" (the real size may be larger), or none.

aboutThis.headline.downloadedFrom: {what}{sizeShown, select, exact {, <size></size>} atLeast {, at least <size></size>} other {}}, recorded as downloaded{hasApp, select, yes { with {app}} other {}} from {host}{hasDate, select, yes { on <date></date>} other {}}

@aboutThis.headline.downloadedFrom.description: The one-line summary at the top of the "Tell me about this" card for a file the system recorded as downloaded. "Recorded as": Cmdr didn't check it. <size></size> becomes the size, <date></date> the date. No closing period.

what.description: What the item is, for example "Disk image".

app.description: The app that downloaded it, for example "Chrome".

hasApp.description: "yes" when the record names the app.

hasDate.description: "yes" when the record has a date.

aboutThis.headline.putHereByCmdr: {what}{sizeShown, select, exact {, <size></size>} atLeast {, at least <size></size>} other {}}, {kind, select, copy {copied here} move {moved here} rename {renamed} create {created} extract {extracted here} compress {compressed} other {moved here when deleted}} with Cmdr{hasVolume, select, yes { from {volume}} other {}} on <date></date>

@aboutThis.headline.putHereByCmdr.description: The one-line summary at the top of the "Tell me about this" card for an item a Cmdr operation put where it is. <size></size> becomes the size, <date></date> the date. No closing period.

what.description: What the item is, for example "Image".

kind.description: What the operation did: copy, move, rename, create, extract, compress, or trash.

volume.description: The drive or server it came from, for example "Naspolya".

hasVolume.description: "yes" when it came from another drive.

aboutThis.headline.receivedByMail: {what}{sizeShown, select, exact {, <size></size>} atLeast {, at least <size></size>} other {}}, recorded as a Mail attachment{hasDate, select, yes { saved on <date></date>} other {}}

@aboutThis.headline.receivedByMail.description: The one-line summary at the top of the "Tell me about this" card for a file macOS recorded as saved from an email in Apple Mail. It never names the sender. No closing period.

what.description: What the item is, for example "PDF".

hasDate.description: "yes" when the record has a date.

aboutThis.headline.receivedByAirDrop: {what}{sizeShown, select, exact {, <size></size>} atLeast {, at least <size></size>} other {}}, recorded as received over AirDrop{hasDate, select, yes { on <date></date>} other {}}

@aboutThis.headline.receivedByAirDrop.description: The one-line summary at the top of the "Tell me about this" card for a file macOS recorded as received over AirDrop. It never names the sender. No closing period.

what.description: What the item is, for example "Image".

hasDate.description: "yes" when the record has a date.

aboutThis.headline.dataOfApp: {what}{sizeShown, select, exact {, <size></size>} atLeast {, at least <size></size>} other {}}, {certainty, select, probable {probably {app}’s data} other {{app}’s data}}

@aboutThis.headline.dataOfApp.description: The one-line summary at the top of the "Tell me about this" card for a folder that holds an installed app's data. "probably" when Cmdr matched it by the folder's name only. No closing period.

aboutThis.headline.dataOfMissingApp: {what}{sizeShown, select, exact {, <size></size>} atLeast {, at least <size></size>} other {}}, named after {bundleId}, an app that isn’t installed

@aboutThis.headline.dataOfMissingApp.description: The one-line summary at the top of the "Tell me about this" card for a Library folder named after an app that isn't installed on this Mac. No closing period.

aboutThis.headline.downloadedBy: {what}{sizeShown, select, exact {, <size></size>} atLeast {, at least <size></size>} other {}}, recorded as downloaded with {app}{hasDate, select, yes { on <date></date>} other {}}

@aboutThis.headline.downloadedBy.description: The one-line summary at the top of the "Tell me about this" card for a file the system recorded as downloaded by an app, without saying from where. No closing period.

app.description: The app that downloaded it, for example "Chrome".

hasDate.description: "yes" when the record has a date.

aboutThis.headline.lastOpened: {what}{sizeShown, select, exact {, <size></size>} atLeast {, at least <size></size>} other {}}, last opened <date></date>

@aboutThis.headline.lastOpened.description: The one-line summary at the top of the "Tell me about this" card when the system recorded when the item was last opened. <date></date> becomes that date. No closing period.

what.description: What the item is, for example "Pages document".

@aboutThis.bundle.named.description: Answer on the "Bundle" row of the "Tell me about this" card: the name and version an app or package states about itself. No closing period.

name.description: The app's own name, for example "Slack".

aboutThis.bundle.unnamed: {hasVersion, select, yes {No name stated, version {version}} other {No name or version stated}}

@aboutThis.bundle.unnamed.description: Answer on the "Bundle" row of the "Tell me about this" card when the app's description file states no name. No closing period.

@aboutThis.signature.unsigned.description: Answer on the Signature row of the "Tell me about this" card when the program carries no code signature. No closing period.

aboutThis.signature.adHoc: Signed without a developer’s identity, like a local build

@aboutThis.signature.adHoc.description: Answer on the Signature row of the "Tell me about this" card for an "ad hoc" signature: signed, but naming no developer (typical of something built on this computer). No closing period.

aboutThis.signature.developerId: {matches, select, yes {Signed by {org} (team {team})} other {Carries a signature from {org} (team {team})}}

@aboutThis.signature.developerId.description: Answer on the Signature row of the "Tell me about this" card for a program signed with a developer's certificate. "Signed by" only when Cmdr compared the program with its signature and they matched; otherwise "Carries a signature from", since a signature can be copied onto a changed program. Never "verified" or "trusted". No closing period.

org.description: The developer's name from the certificate, for example "Slack Technologies, Inc.".

team.description: Apple's team id for that developer, for example "BQR82RBBHL".

matches.description: "yes" when the program matched its signature.

aboutThis.signature.appStore: {matches, select, yes {Signed by the Mac App Store} other {Carries the Mac App Store’s signature}}

@aboutThis.signature.appStore.description: Answer on the Signature row of the "Tell me about this" card for an app signed by Apple's Mac App Store. "Signed by" only when the program matched its signature. Never "verified" or "trusted". No closing period.

matches.description: "yes" when the program matched its signature.

aboutThis.signature.apple: {matches, select, yes {Signed by Apple} other {Carries Apple’s signature}}

@aboutThis.signature.apple.description: Answer on the Signature row of the "Tell me about this" card for Apple's own software. "Signed by" only when the program matched its signature. Never "verified" or "trusted". No closing period.

matches.description: "yes" when the program matched its signature.

aboutThis.signature.unrecognized: Carries a signature from an authority Cmdr doesn’t know

@aboutThis.signature.unrecognized.description: Answer on the Signature row of the "Tell me about this" card when the signature names an authority Cmdr doesn't know. No closing period.

aboutThis.signature.executableDiffers: Its program doesn’t match the signature it carries.

@aboutThis.signature.executableDiffers.description: Warning line on the Signature row of the "Tell me about this" card: Cmdr compared the app's program with its signature and they differ, so the program was changed after signing.

aboutThis.signature.checkTimedOut: Cmdr didn’t finish comparing its program with the signature.

@aboutThis.signature.checkTimedOut.description: Line on the Signature row of the "Tell me about this" card when comparing the program with its signature took too long (a very large app), so nothing was confirmed.

aboutThis.signature.checkUnavailable: Cmdr couldn’t compare its program with the signature.

@aboutThis.signature.checkUnavailable.description: Line on the Signature row of the "Tell me about this" card when comparing the program with its signature couldn't run.

aboutThis.signature.ticketPresent: A notarization ticket is stapled to it.

@aboutThis.signature.ticketPresent.description: Line on the Signature row of the "Tell me about this" card: the app carries Apple's notarization ticket (Apple scanned it before release). "Notarization" is Apple's term.

aboutThis.signature.ticketAbsent: No notarization ticket is stapled to it. macOS can also check with Apple online.

@aboutThis.signature.ticketAbsent.description: Line on the Signature row of the "Tell me about this" card when the app carries no notarization ticket. The second sentence says that this alone doesn't mean it was never notarized.

@aboutThis.lastOpened.noRecord.description: Muted one-line answer on the "Last opened" row of the "Tell me about this" card when the system has no record of the item being opened. It doesn't mean it was never opened. No closing period.

aboutThis.lastOpened.known: <date></date>{hasCount, select, yes {, {count, plural, one {opened once} other {opened {countText} times}}} other {}}

@aboutThis.lastOpened.known.description: Answer on the "Last opened" row of the "Tell me about this" card: the date the system recorded, and how many times it was opened when that's recorded. <date></date> becomes the date. No closing period.

count.description: How many times, as a number.

aboutThis.importance.band: {band, select, high {High} medium {Medium} low {Low} other {Not ranked}}

@aboutThis.importance.band.description: Answer on the "Importance" row of the "Tell me about this" card: how important Cmdr's drive index scores the folder. "Not ranked" is for folders the ranking leaves out on purpose (caches, build output, hidden, system, and temporary folders, app data in the Library); it never says the contents don't matter.

band.description: high, medium, low, or floored (left out of the ranking).

@aboutThis.importance.because.description: Muted second line on the "Importance" row of the "Tell me about this" card: the signals behind the score. No closing period.

reasons.description: A list joined with commas and "and", for example "recent changes and your visits".

@aboutThis.importance.reason.projectMark.description: One reason in the "Because of …" list on the Importance row: the folder holds a project file (a package.json, a Cargo.toml). Lowercase, joins a list.

@aboutThis.importance.reason.mtimeRecenc.description: One reason in the "Because of …" list on the Importance row: files in it changed recently. Lowercase, joins a list.

@aboutThis.importance.reason.visitActivi.description: One reason in the "Because of …" list on the Importance row: the user often opens this folder in Cmdr. Lowercase, joins a list.

@aboutThis.importance.reason.lastUsed.description: One reason in the "Because of …" list on the Importance row: the system recorded recent use. Lowercase, joins a list.

@aboutThis.importance.reason.extensionDi.description: One reason in the "Because of …" list on the Importance row: it holds many different kinds of files. Lowercase, joins a list.

@aboutThis.importance.reason.projectRoot.description: One reason in the "Because of …" list on the Importance row: the folder is the top folder of a software project. Lowercase, joins a list.

@aboutThis.importance.reason.userContent.description: One reason in the "Because of …" list on the Importance row: it sits among the user's own documents. Lowercase, joins a list.

aboutThis.importance.floor.nameDenyliste: Cmdr doesn’t rank folders whose name marks generated files

@aboutThis.importance.floor.nameDenylist.description: Muted line on the "Importance" row of the "Tell me about this" card, under "Not ranked": Cmdr's folder ranking leaves this folder out because its name (like "node_modules" or "cache") marks files a tool generates. It describes Cmdr's ranking, never whether the folder's contents matter. No closing period.

aboutThis.importance.floor.hiddenOrSyste: Cmdr doesn’t rank hidden, system, or temporary folders

@aboutThis.importance.floor.hiddenOrSyst.description: Muted line on the "Importance" row of the "Tell me about this" card, under "Not ranked": Cmdr's folder ranking leaves out hidden folders, the system's folders, app data in the Library, and temporary folders. It describes Cmdr's ranking, never whether the folder's contents matter. No closing period.

aboutThis.importance.floor.underFlooredA: Cmdr doesn’t rank folders inside one it leaves out

@aboutThis.importance.floor.underFloored.description: Muted line on the "Importance" row of the "Tell me about this" card, under "Not ranked": the folder sits inside one Cmdr's folder ranking leaves out (a cache, build output, a hidden folder). It describes Cmdr's ranking, never whether the folder's contents matter. No closing period.

aboutThis.importance.floor.other: Cmdr leaves folders like this out of its ranking

@aboutThis.importance.floor.other.description: Muted line on the "Importance" row of the "Tell me about this" card, under "Not ranked", for a reason Cmdr has no words for yet. It describes Cmdr's ranking, never whether the folder's contents matter. No closing period.

@aboutThis.importance.reason.other.description: One reason in the "Because of …" list on the Importance row, for a signal Cmdr has no words for yet. Lowercase, joins a list.

aboutThis.importance.visits: {count, plural, one {Cmdr visited it once} other {Cmdr visited it {countText} times}}

@aboutThis.importance.visits.description: Muted line on the "Importance" row of the "Tell me about this" card: how many times a Cmdr pane opened this folder. No closing period.

count.description: How many times, as a number.

@aboutThis.importance.stale.description: Muted line on the "Importance" row of the "Tell me about this" card when the score is older than the drive index's latest update. No closing period.

@aboutThis.owner.byBundleId.description: Answer on the "Belongs to" row of the "Tell me about this" card when the folder is named after an installed app's identifier, so Cmdr is sure. Usually just the app's name; reorder only if your language needs words around it.

app.description: The app's name, for example "Commander One".

aboutThis.owner.byBundleIdHow: The folder carries the app’s identifier, {bundleId}.

@aboutThis.owner.byBundleIdHow.description: Muted second line on the "Belongs to" row of the "Tell me about this" card, saying how Cmdr knows the owner: the folder's name is the app's identifier.

aboutThis.owner.notInstalled: Left over from an app that isn’t installed ({bundleId})

@aboutThis.owner.notInstalled.description: Answer on the "Belongs to" row of the "Tell me about this" card when the folder is named after an app identifier and no installed app has it. It doesn't say anything about whether deleting is fine. No closing period.

@aboutThis.owner.byName.description: Answer on the "Belongs to" row of the "Tell me about this" card when exactly one installed app has the folder's name, so it's a likely match, not a sure one. No closing period.

aboutThis.owner.byNameHow: Only this app has the folder’s name.

@aboutThis.owner.byNameHow.description: Muted second line on the "Belongs to" row of the "Tell me about this" card, saying how Cmdr guessed the owner: one installed app has the folder's name.

@aboutThis.owner.partOfOs.description: Answer on the "Belongs to" row of the "Tell me about this" card when one of Apple's own installer records lists the item. No closing period.

pkgId.description: The installer package's identifier, for example "com.apple.files.data-template".

@aboutThis.owner.installedBy.description: Answer on the "Belongs to" row of the "Tell me about this" card when an installer package's record lists the item. No closing period.

pkgId.description: The installer package's identifier, for example "com.example.driver".

@aboutThis.owner.homebrew.description: Answer on the "Belongs to" row of the "Tell me about this" card for something Homebrew installed. "Homebrew" is the package manager's name, and "cask" and "formula" are its own terms for an app and a command-line tool; keep them. No closing period.

name.description: The formula's or cask's name, for example "ffmpeg".

@aboutThis.owner.insideApp.description: Answer on the "Belongs to" row of the "Tell me about this" card for something inside an app's bundle. No closing period.

@aboutThis.owner.noReceipt.description: Muted one-line answer on the "Belongs to" row of the "Tell me about this" card when no installer package's record lists the item. Ordinary, not a warning. No closing period.

aboutThis.owner.ambiguous: Several installed apps could own this, so Cmdr doesn’t pick one.

@aboutThis.owner.ambiguous.description: Answer on the "Belongs to" row of the "Tell me about this" card when several apps match the folder's name (a vendor folder like "Google" or "Microsoft").

aboutThis.git.repo: In <repo></repo>{hasBranch, select, yes {, on {branch}} other {, with no branch checked out}}

@aboutThis.git.repo.description: Answer on the Git row of the "Tell me about this" card: the repository the item sits in, and its checked-out branch. <repo></repo> becomes the repository's folder. No closing period.

hasBranch.description: "yes" when a branch is checked out.

@aboutThis.git.copyRepo.description: Accessible name and hover hint of the copy button beside the repository's folder on the Git row. It copies the full path.

@aboutThis.git.clean.description: Second line on the Git row of the "Tell me about this" card: git tracks the item and it matches the last commit. No closing period.

@aboutThis.git.modified.description: Second line on the Git row of the "Tell me about this" card: the item has changes that aren't committed. No closing period.

@aboutThis.git.untracked.description: Second line on the Git row of the "Tell me about this" card: the item is new to git, which doesn't keep a copy of it. No closing period.

@aboutThis.git.ignored.description: Second line on the Git row of the "Tell me about this" card: an ignore rule covers the item. No closing period.

aboutThis.folderSize.known: {coverage, select, lowerBound {At least <size></size>} other {<size></size>}} in {files, plural, one {one file} other {{filesText} files}} and {folders, plural, one {one folder} other {{foldersText} folders}}

@aboutThis.folderSize.known.description: Answer on the Size row of the "Tell me about this" card for a folder: its whole size and how many files and folders it holds, from Cmdr's drive index. "At least" when the index hasn't covered all of it. <size></size> becomes the size. No closing period.

coverage.description: lowerBound (the real size may be larger) or exact.

files.description: How many files, as a number.

folders.description: How many folders, as a number.

aboutThis.folderSize.stale: From the drive index’s last pass, so it may have changed since

@aboutThis.folderSize.stale.description: Muted second line on a folder's Size row of the "Tell me about this" card when the index's numbers are older than its latest scan. No closing period.

aboutThis.folderSize.updating: The drive index is updating this folder right now

@aboutThis.folderSize.updating.description: Muted second line on a folder's Size row of the "Tell me about this" card while Cmdr's drive index is still catching up with changes in it. No closing period.

aboutThis.folderSize.symlinks: Links to other places aren’t counted

@aboutThis.folderSize.symlinks.description: Muted second line on a folder's Size row of the "Tell me about this" card when the folder holds symbolic links, whose targets the size leaves out. No closing period.

@aboutThis.contents.count.description: Answer on the Contents row of the "Tell me about this" card for a folder: how many items sit directly in it. No closing period.

count.description: How many items, as a number.

aboutThis.appData.count: {count, plural, =0 {None that Cmdr’s index knows of} one {One folder} other {{countText} folders}}

@aboutThis.appData.count.description: Answer on the "Its data in your Library" row of the "Tell me about this" card for an app: how many folders in the Library are named after it. No closing period.

count.description: How many folders, as a number.

aboutThis.removal.uncommittedWork: It has changes no commit holds, so git can’t bring those back.

@aboutThis.removal.uncommittedWork.description: One line under "What removing it means" on the "Tell me about this" card: the item has uncommitted changes in git. A consequence, never advice.

aboutThis.removal.untrackedNotInGit: Git doesn’t track it, so git can’t bring it back.

@aboutThis.removal.untrackedNotInGit.description: One line under "What removing it means": the item is in a git repository but git keeps no copy of it. A consequence, never advice.

aboutThis.removal.ignoredByGit: Git ignores it, so git can’t bring it back.

@aboutThis.removal.ignoredByGit.description: One line under "What removing it means": an ignore rule covers the item, so git keeps no copy. It doesn't claim any tool can recreate it. A consequence, never advice.

aboutThis.removal.userDocument: Nothing Cmdr knows of made this or could make it again.

@aboutThis.removal.userDocument.description: One line under "What removing it means": no app, installer, or tool Cmdr knows of created the item or could recreate it, so it's likely the person's own. A consequence, never advice.

aboutThis.removal.removesApp: This removes the app. Cmdr can’t tell yet how much of its data stays in your Library.

@aboutThis.removal.removesApp.description: One line under "What removing it means" for an app, when Cmdr doesn't know (yet) which of its folders in the user's Library would stay behind. "Library" is the macOS folder of that name.

aboutThis.removal.removesAppDataLeft: {count, plural, =0 {This removes the app. Cmdr’s index knows of none of its data in your Library.} one {This removes the app. Its data in your Library stays: <size></size> in one folder.} other {This removes the app. Its data in your Library stays: <size></size> in {countText} folders.}}

@aboutThis.removal.removesAppDataLeft.description: One line under "What removing it means" for an app: how much of the app's data in the user's Library would stay behind. <size></size> becomes the total size.

count.description: How many folders, as a number.

aboutThis.removal.appData: {certainty, select, probable {It’s probably {app}’s data, and {app} may lose what it keeps here.} other {It’s {app}’s data, and {app} may lose what it keeps here.}}

@aboutThis.removal.appData.description: One line under "What removing it means": the item holds an installed app's data, and that app may lose settings or content. "probably" when Cmdr matched it by name only. A consequence, never advice.

aboutThis.removal.installedByReceipt: {partOfOs, select, yes {macOS installed it, and parts of macOS may need it.} other {The package {pkgId} installed it, and what it installed may need it.}}

@aboutThis.removal.installedByReceipt.description: One line under "What removing it means": an installer put the item here, and the software it installed may need it. A consequence, never advice.

aboutThis.removal.installedByHomebrew: Homebrew installed it as part of {name}, which may stop working.

@aboutThis.removal.installedByHomebrew.description: One line under "What removing it means": Homebrew (a package manager; keep the name) installed the item, and that software may stop working. A consequence, never advice.

name.description: The formula's or cask's name, for example "ffmpeg".

aboutThis.removal.leftoverOfUninstalledA: It’s named after {bundleId}, an app that isn’t installed. Cmdr can’t tell whether anything else uses it.

@aboutThis.removal.leftoverOfUninstalled.description: One line under "What removing it means": the folder is named after an app that isn't installed. The second sentence keeps it honest: Cmdr doesn't know whether something else still uses it. Never say it's safe to delete.

aboutThis.removal.recordedDownload: {platform, select, macos {macOS recorded this as downloaded from {host}. Cmdr can’t tell whether the site still has it.} other {Your browser recorded this as downloaded from {host}. Cmdr can’t tell whether the site still has it.}}

@aboutThis.removal.recordedDownload.description: One line under "What removing it means" for a downloaded file. It says only what was recorded; it never promises the file can be downloaded again.

aboutThis.removal.gitCanRestore: Git can restore it from the last commit.

@aboutThis.removal.gitCanRestore.description: One line under "What removing it means": git tracks the item with no changes, so git can bring it back. A consequence, never advice.

aboutThis.removal.rebuildablePackageMana: A package manager can fetch this again, which takes time and a network.

@aboutThis.removal.rebuildablePackageMan.description: One line under "What removing it means" for installed dependencies (like node_modules): a package manager can download them again. A consequence, never advice.

aboutThis.removal.rebuildableBuildTool: A build tool can make this again, which takes time.

@aboutThis.removal.rebuildableBuildTool.description: One line under "What removing it means" for build output: the build tool that made it can make it again. A consequence, never advice.

aboutThis.removal.regeneratedCache: {hasApp, select, yes {It’s {app}’s cache: {app} writes it again, and is slower until it has.} other {It’s a cache: whatever wrote it writes it again, and is slower until it has.}}

@aboutThis.removal.regeneratedCache.description: One line under "What removing it means" for a cache folder. A consequence, never advice.

app.description: The app whose cache it is, for example "Slack".

hasApp.description: "yes" when Cmdr knows whose cache it is.

aboutThis.removal.otherNamesRemain: {count, plural, one {One other name points to the same contents, which stays.} other {{countText} other names point to the same contents, which stays.}}

@aboutThis.removal.otherNamesRemain.description: One line under "What removing it means" for a file with hard links: removing this name leaves the contents reachable through the others. A consequence, never advice.

count.description: How many other names, as a number.

aboutThis.removal.linkOnly: It’s a link: removing it leaves what it points to.

@aboutThis.removal.linkOnly.description: One line under "What removing it means" for a symbolic link. A consequence, never advice.

aboutThis.removal.cantTell: Cmdr can’t tell what depends on this.

@aboutThis.removal.cantTell.description: One line under "What removing it means" when Cmdr doesn't know enough to say. An honest answer, never a warning or advice.

@aboutThis.removal.more.description: Button under "What removing it means" that shows the rest of the consequences beyond the first two. No closing period.

count.description: How many more, as a number.

@aboutThis.removal.less.description: Button under "What removing it means" that hides the extra consequences again. No closing period.
